name: Ahmad Ali
title: During my time leading HEC IA, I recognized a recurring challenge in fostering interdisciplinary collaboration for AI projects. Traditional academic structures often silo students by their primary fields, hindering the cross-pollination of ideas essential for innovative AI solutions. To overcome this, I "hacked" the conventional student organization model by implementing a structured, project-based team formation system that actively prioritized diversity in academic backgrounds and skill sets. Instead of allowing self-selection based on existing friendships or superficial interests, we developed a matching algorithm that considered complementary technical skills, domain expertise (e.g., business, ethics, design), and individual learning objectives. This wasn't a computer hack in the literal sense, but a strategic re-engineering of how human capital was organized and deployed within our community. The advantage gained was significant: projects developed within these diverse teams consistently demonstrated higher levels of innovation, practical applicability, and a more holistic consideration of societal impact, directly aligning with the mission of HEC IA to push the boundaries of AI responsibly. This approach not only enhanced the quality of our output but also created a more dynamic and enriching learning environment for all participants.
conviction_themes: Interdisciplinary collaboration is critical for innovative AI solutions
Traditional academic silos hinder cross-pollination of ideas in AI
Diversity in technical skills and domain expertise drives better AI outcomes
AI projects should consider holistic societal impact
previous_experiences: Led HEC IA student organization with focus on project-based team formation
bio_text: Ahmad Ali leads HEC IA, an initiative to foster interdisciplinary collaboration in AI through strategic team formation. He advocates for diverse, cross-functional teams combining technical skills, domain expertise, and ethical considerations to drive innovative and responsible AI solutions.
